reason: A DeepSeek Harness web client skin plugin focused on theme switching, wallpaper-based color extraction, custom colors, visual effects, and persistent appearance settings.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页客户端提供预设与自定义皮肤、壁纸取色、色彩调整及沉浸式外观设置。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness web client skin plugin offering preset and custom themes, wallpaper color extraction, color adjustments, and immersive appearance controls.

capabilities: Applies preset and custom themes to the DeepSeek Harness web client
Accepts local image uploads for client-side dominant-color extraction
Persists theme settings and image-related display preferences in localStorage
Adjusts wallpaper opacity, blur, noise, and global color saturation
